title: Q18
description:
“In that He Himself has suffered, being tempted, He is able to aid those who are tempted.”
Read: Deut 8:2–3, Mat 4:1–11, Isa 53:3–4
a) Israel was tested forty years in the wilderness. Jesus answered His testing with Deut 8:3. What does that wilderness background bring forward about the kind of help He gives?
